sentence: The Psychosocial Assessment Tool has been proposed as a pragmatic triage instrument to identify family risk and match intensity of services to need, supporting a tiered approach in which universal psychoeducation is supplemented by targeted or intensive intervention for higher-risk families ref [92].
title: Psychosocial Assessment Tool 2.0_General (PAT2.0_GEN): a screener for psychosocial risk in families of children newly diagnosed with cancer

sentence: Consensus standards for psychosocial care in pediatric oncology argue that psychosocial services should be delivered by qualified professionals as part of the core treatment team, with communication across disciplines and continuity into survivorship or bereavement care ref [3].
